# Feature Integration Agent

A custom agent for planning, implementing, and reviewing new features. Coordinates code updates, tests, docs, and hooks for seamless integration.

## Example Prompts
- "Run feature integration agent for deck builder."
- "Plan and implement asset manager improvements."
- "Review plugin showcase integration."
